final_checkpoint_selection: Fixed final step300; no favorable intermediate selection.
objective: Maximize J_theta - eta0*C_theta, normalized by baseline expected query cost. J is signed actual-MH potential decrease, C is importance-estimated scored-proposal raw cost. eta0 is the frozen FIT baseline J/C. Add an empirical forward/reverse log-ratio penalty; it is not a KL claim.
edge_sampling: Half parent/replica/condition-balanced empirical weights, half the same weights times absolute baseline cost-adjusted utility. Divide every minibatch contribution by its exact index sampling probability. No scored/accepted-only conditioning.
validation: All12 newly hashed selection parents; report every condition, raw J, C, J/C, constitutional flow, scored-edge ESS and weight range. These remain internal empirical proxies, not molecular efficiency or final evaluation.
scope: Two-seed offline pilot from exact physical initialization. No previous learned checkpoint, evaluated48-parent cohort, old six-composition test data or reserved outcomes enter fitting.
